verdict.rationale: Notion's REST API lets scripts read/create/update pages and databases programmatically (notion-docs-1, notion-docs-2), which could be used to loop through and bulk-update many items, but there is no documented native bulk/batch endpoint, batch-operation semantics, or evidence of bulk-scale rate limits being addressed. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API endpoints or documented support for high-volume operations, independent confirmation of bulk workflows succeeding at scale.
